# confinement

Requested and observed confinement of local test commands. No automatic fallback.

`intake.confinement` is one of intake's bounded contexts. [All domains](./index.mdx).

## Types

### `AppliedConfinement`

`intake.confinement.AppliedConfinement` is a record of nine fields:

- `backend` — `intake.confinement.Backend`
- `profile_digest` — `String`
- `capability_snapshot` — `String`
- `cgroup` — `String`
- `filesystem` — `String`
- `network` — `String`
- `profile` — `String`
- `writable_scopes` — `List<String>`
- `read_only_roots` — `List<intake.confinement.ToolchainRoot>`

### `Backend`

`intake.confinement.Backend` is one of `Substrate` and `None`.

### `ConfinementProfile`

`intake.confinement.ConfinementProfile` is a record of nine fields:

- `backend` — `intake.confinement.Backend`
- `network` — `String`
- `writable_scopes` — `List<String>`
- `read_only_roots` — `List<intake.confinement.ToolchainRoot>`
- `environment` — `List<intake.confinement.EnvironmentEntry>`
- `timeout_ms` — `Integer`
- `memory_bytes` — `Integer`
- `processes` — `Integer`
- `cpu_millis` — `Integer`

### `ConfinementRefusal`

`intake.confinement.ConfinementRefusal` is one of `BackendMissing`, `CgroupUndelegated`, `ScopeInvalid`, `WorkspaceNameInvalid` and `CapabilityUnserved`.

### `EnvironmentEntry`

`intake.confinement.EnvironmentEntry` is a record of two fields:

- `name` — `String`
- `value` — `String`

### `ToolchainRoot`

`intake.confinement.ToolchainRoot` is a record of two fields:

- `host_path` — `String`
- `mount` — `String`

Three of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `intake.confinement.AppliedConfinement`, `intake.confinement.ConfinementProfile` and `intake.confinement.ConfinementRefusal`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names them, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
